messages:
ajay: kicking off a short-action thread to close out GPU capacity/autoscale postmortem items. need owners, single-date due dates, and a verification plan. drop confirmations and one-line blockers only.
kelly: i'll take the cloud quota work for aws. filing request now. will paste ticket id.
ajay: thanks — paste the id + expected ETA.
kelly: filed AWS-REQ-6399 (owner=kelly). asked for expedited review; quota team ETA ~72h.
samir: i'll own scheduler tuning. high-level: bias binpacking to favor short-running jobs, drop preempt threshold to 0.6, and add a 3-node emergency fallback pool. will include metric gates.
leah: i've refreshed the headroom workbook with a 6-week demand curve and recommend a 15% scheduled buffer for confirmed peak windows. doc: https://redwood/ops/headroom-guidance-2026 (internal).
ajay: owners — please add a single concrete due date for PM tracking (one date per item).
kelly: AWS-REQ-6399 target approval 2026-06-15, infra nodes provisioned + smoke tests 2026-06-17 (owner=kelly).
samir: timeline for scheduler changes: PR opened by 2026-06-03, canary rollout 2026-06-06, full rollout 2026-06-10 if canary metrics stable. rollback gate: p95 increase < 5% and error rate < 0.1%. (owner=samir)
leah: headroom tasks i own: (1) add scheduled autoscale buffer for peak windows (owner=leah) due 2026-05-31; (2) add headroom telemetry alert headroom_percent < 12% for 5m (owner=infra-alerts) due 2026-05-28.
infra-alerts-bot: created alert ALRT-4700: headroom_percent < 12% for 5m. assigned to oncall.
ajay: who will run post-change regressions and publish artifacts?
samir: i'll run the ml-evals regression suite and upload before/after dashboards to RI-1725. will include canary logs and a short rollback checklist.
kelly: ops-infra QA for provisioning -> owner=rafael. rafael, can you confirm provisioning windows after quota clears?
rafael: confirmed. provisioning and infra smoke tests scheduled 2026-06-17 to 2026-06-18 pending quota approval. will include node readiness and kube-level validation.
leah: noticed recurring spikes Tue 02:00 UTC tied to scheduled retrain starts. mitigation options: stagger retrain starts across a 6-hour window or move retrains to a dedicated pool. owner=ml-platform (tanya) due 2026-06-14.
tanya: ack'd. ml-platform will prototype staggering first and report back with a one-page plan.
ajay: i've opened short-tracking tickets so leadership can follow:
- RI-1725 Scheduler tuning + regressions (owner=samir) due=2026-06-10
- RI-1726 Quota & provisioning (AWS-REQ-6399) (owner=kelly) due=2026-06-17
- RI-1727 Headroom alert + scheduled buffer (owner=leah) due=2026-05-31
samir: i'll attach perf graphs, k8s pod traces, and canary dashboards to RI-1725. also adding a brief runbook for rollback.
kelly: after nodes are provisioned, propose a controlled burst test: 3-hour window, 2x capacity to dedicated pool during a low-traffic slot to validate autoscale behavior. will coordinate IAM/kms with ops-infra.
rafael: agree. we'll run the controlled burst with strict rollback criteria: success = headroom >= 8% and no P95 regression > 10%. rollback action = immediate scale-down + traffic routing to fallback pool. ops-infra owns exec.
leah: infra-alerts, can you add a temporary test rule to alert on headroom_delta > 8% during the burst?
infra-alerts-bot: created temp alert ALRT-4701: headroom_delta > 8% during controlled-burst for 1m. assigned to oncall.
ajay: propose a 15-minute weekly sync until all RI tickets are resolved. suggested slot: wednesdays 17:00 UTC. first sync 2026-05-27 17:00 UTC. can everyone make that?
samir: available.
kelly: available.
leah: available.
rafael: available.
tanya: available.
ajay: ops-bot, please create the calendar invite and make it recurring.
ops-bot: created calendar event "GPU capacity remediation weekly" starting 2026-05-27T17:00:00Z recurring weekly. invitees: ajay, kelly, samir, leah, rafael, tanya.
ajay: owners please update your RI ticket with a one-line status before the first sync. i'll ping 24h prior. any blockers?
leah: none from headroom side.
samir: tiny lint fix on scheduler PR; will push today.
kelly: waiting on quota team review; otherwise ready.
rafael: prepping provisioning playbook and smoke-test checklist.
ajay: thanks all — marking this thread as canonical for remediation updates until RI-1725/1726/1727 are closed. keep replies short and paste ticket IDs/links. :white_check_mark:
